_about: Public demo workspace for judges and visitors (Noa.Demo). Everything here is made up: a fictional company, people and chat. Times are relative to when it loads (h = hours ago, due_in = days from today). Loaded through the real pipeline: messages become episodes, proposals cite them, a lead approves them.

messages.author: maya
messages.text: Kicking off the Tulpa v2 cycle. Goal for the next two weeks: answers that cite their sources and a memory that survives restarts.

messages.author: rohan
messages.text: I'll take retrieval. Thinking hybrid: keyword search plus a graph walk from the people and projects in the question.

messages.author: maya
messages.text: @Rohan Das can you have the retrieval eval set ready by Friday? 40 real questions from the team is enough.

messages.author: rohan
messages.text: Yes, eval set by Friday.

messages.author: priya
messages.text: For memory, Postgres append-only log as the source of truth, and we project it into the graph. Then we can always rebuild.

messages.author: arjun
messages.text: Agreed. Decision: the event log is the source of truth, the graph is a projection we can drop and replay.

messages.author: maya
messages.text: @Priya Nair can you own the projector? Target next Wednesday.

messages.author: priya
messages.text: On it, projector by Wednesday.

messages.author: dev
messages.text: I can write the onboarding guide for Tulpa once citations land. Who should review it?

messages.author: maya
messages.text: Dev, yes please, onboarding guide is yours. I'll review.

messages.author: rohan
messages.text: Citations prototype works: every claim gets a [1] that links to the message it came from.

messages.author: maya
messages.text: Love it. Let's decide: no answer ships without at least one source. If we can't cite, we say we don't know.

messages.author: rohan
messages.text: Eval set is done, 42 questions. Hybrid retrieval is at 81% on it, keyword-only was 63%.

messages.author: priya
messages.text: Projector is merged. Replaying the full log takes about 40 seconds on staging.

messages.author: arjun
messages.text: We still need rate limiting on the Tulpa API before the beta. Nobody has picked it up yet.

messages.author: rohan
messages.text: Working on answer streaming now, should be done in a couple of days.

messages.author: maya
messages.text: @Rohan Das can you also add a 'who knows about this' tool to Tulpa? Graph-based, using who worked on what.

messages.author: rohan
messages.text: Sure, I'll do the expert finder after streaming. Say end of next week.

messages.author: arjun
messages.text: Atlas sprint: offline mode is the whole sprint. Field teams lose signal constantly.

messages.author: zoe
messages.text: I've got the offline states in Figma: queued, syncing, conflict. Sharing tomorrow.

messages.author: arjun
messages.text: @Kabir Shah can you build the offline queue for checklist submissions? End of next week.

messages.author: kabir
messages.text: Yep, offline queue is mine.

messages.author: kabir
messages.text: How do we resolve conflicts when two people edit the same checklist offline?

messages.author: arjun
messages.text: Last write wins per field, and we keep the other value in history so nothing is lost. Let's go with that.

messages.author: zoe
messages.text: Offline designs are final. @Kabir Shah the conflict banner spec is in the file.

messages.author: ishita
messages.text: I'll write the airplane-mode test plan for offline. Want it before Kabir's PR lands.

messages.author: kabir
messages.text: Photo uploads are blocked: the S3 presigned URLs expire before slow connections finish.

messages.author: arjun
messages.text: Let's switch photo uploads to multipart with resumable chunks. @Kabir Shah can you take that once the queue is in?

messages.author: kabir
messages.text: Offline queue is merged and on TestFlight.

messages.author: ishita
messages.text: Airplane-mode test plan run: 2 bugs, both in photo retry. Filed.

messages.author: zoe
messages.text: Need someone to review the new onboarding screens for Atlas before Friday's build.

messages.author: arjun
messages.text: Ledger plan: move from flat plans to usage-based, migrate everyone to Stripe Billing by the end of the month.

messages.author: priya
messages.text: I'll do the usage metering service. Events in, daily rollups out.

messages.author: arjun
messages.text: @Priya Nair metering by the 20th please, finance wants a dry run.

messages.author: arjun
messages.text: Decision: we bill monthly in arrears for usage, seats stay prepaid.

messages.author: ishita
messages.text: I'll build the invoice regression suite: last 3 months of invoices replayed against the new engine.

messages.author: priya
messages.text: Metering is in staging. Rollups match the old numbers within 0.3%.

messages.author: arjun
messages.text: Change of plan after the finance call: usage is billed weekly for accounts over $5k a month, monthly for the rest. This replaces the monthly-only decision.

messages.author: priya
messages.text: Stripe migration script is written but blocked: we don't have the production Stripe restricted key yet.

messages.author: ishita
messages.text: Invoice regression suite: 1,204 invoices replayed, 3 mismatches, all rounding. Fixing the test, not the engine.

messages.author: priya
messages.text: The metering dry run needs two more days, finance added a new usage type. Moving it to the 24th.

messages.author: maya
messages.text: Beacon relaunch: new pricing page, docs and a changelog. Launch with Ledger's new plans.

messages.author: dev
messages.text: I'll write the pricing page copy and the launch post.

messages.author: maya
messages.text: @Kabir Shah can you build the docs site on the new template? Two weeks.

messages.author: kabir
messages.text: Docs site, sure, after Atlas offline ships.

messages.author: zoe
messages.text: Pricing page designs are up. Three tiers plus usage calculator.

messages.author: maya
messages.text: Decision: we show prices in USD only at launch, local currency later.

messages.author: dev
messages.text: Pricing copy draft is done, waiting on final numbers from Ledger.

messages.author: zoe
messages.text: @Dev Patel can you write the changelog entries for the last 3 releases? We need them for launch.

messages.author: dev
messages.text: Yes, changelog by Monday.

messages.author: maya
messages.text: Reminder: beta launch for Tulpa and the new Ledger plans is end of month. Ship small, ship often.

messages.author: arjun
messages.text: Decision for all repos: every PR needs one review and green CI before merge. No exceptions near launch.

messages.author: dev
messages.text: Anyone know who owns the status page? Customers asked about uptime during the beta.
